headline: Approved $250,000 spending from Roberts Hot Water Tank, Roberts HVAC schematic design, and a resolution supporting the E-Rate program.
summary: Members approved the consent agenda and a first reading of the MPS wellness policy. They also approved capital project spending, the Roberts HVAC design, and several resolutions, each by a 7-0 vote.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the July 20, 2026 meeting minutes, 7-0.
Approved the first reading of the MPS Wellness Policy, 7-0.
Approved waiving the second reading of the wellness policy, 7-0.
Approved the Roberts HVAC Schematic Design, 7-0.
Approved spending $250,000 from the Roberts Hot Water Tank, as recommended by Member Ruseau, 7-0.
Approved waiving the reading of 2026-06 on amendments to the Rules of the School Committee, 7-0.
Approved 2026-06 on submitting recommended amendments to the Rules of the School Committee, 7-0.
Approved 2026-20, asking the curriculum and instruction subcommittee to meet on the district assessment landscape, 7-0.
Approved 2026-21, a resolution in support of e-bike safety education, 7-0.
Approved 2026-22, thanking Building Committee members and welcoming new members, as amended, 7-0.
Approved 2026-23, a resolution in support of the E-Rate program, 7-0.
